thread:
elaine: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem on the model-serving OOM spikes. I sketched owners/timelines below — please confirm or reassign. Goal: close these actions this sprint.

elaine: Open actions (draft):
• RDW-1245 investigate KV-cache eviction pattern — owner: ryan — due: 2025-06-03
• RDW-1246 add automated mem-pressure alerts + dashboard — owner: nina — due: 2025-06-10
• RDW-1247 run day-long soak on dedicated pool + perf baseline — owner: jackie — due: 2025-06-17
• RDW-1248 implement graceful fallback to smaller model variant — owner: sam — due: 2025-06-24

elaine: RACI (proposal):
R: ryan, nina, jackie, sam
A: elaine
C: infra-team, eng-sre
I: customer-success

ryan: I can take RDW-1245. First step is to reproduce the OOM locally with the traffic snapshot. ETA 2 days.

nina: Confirmed RDW-1246. I'll own the alerting + Grafana dashboard. Prefer retention of 90d for raw logs; will need Eng-SRE signoff for rollups.

jackie: On RDW-1247 — need a dedicated slot on staging for the soak. @elaine can you open a reservation with infra? I'll parallelize across quantized and full models to check regressions.

sam: I can prototype RDW-1248 but need model-ops coordination for packaging smaller variants. Asking +1 week if model-ops is blocked. Concern: fallback might affect latency.

elaine: Action items: @elaine -> open infra slot and ping model-ops. I'll update the postmortem doc with owners and watchers. Weekly check-ins on Fridays until closed. Flag timeline shifts by EOD Wed and update Jira.

pm-bot: RDW-1245 assigned to ryan; RDW-1246 assigned to nina; RDW-1247 assigned to jackie; RDW-1248 assigned to sam. Tickets: https://jira.internal/REDW-1245 https://jira.internal/REDW-1246 https://jira.internal/REDW-1247 https://jira.internal/REDW-1248

sam: For RDW-1248 propose canary fallback at 10% traffic and monitor 95p latency delta + error rate. I'll add an eval plan to the ticket.

ryan: Early finding for RDW-1245 — correlation between request size distribution spikes and eviction windows. Pushing logs and a short repro to the ticket.

nina: Eng-SRE approved 90d retention with daily rollups. I'll post dashboard link once ready.

jackie: Infra slot confirmed for 2025-06-05, thanks @elaine.

elaine: Great. I'll post a short closure checklist in the PM doc and start watchers. :white_check_mark:
